sources.observation: Official AA complete description,categories,differences,three base values and both upgrades are retained in the selected evidence. Super: Slows the movement speed and attack speed of enemies by 25% for 2s and increase caster's strength by 30% per, hero hit that lasts 15s. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of 5 stacks.
